comparison.objective: Select a fitting wrench, release a captive nut, and open a latch arm; candidate calibrates two proximity-switch positions.
comparison.physical_skill: Wrench-size selection and damage-free nut turning versus screwdriver access plus slide-sense-hold-retighten coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Nut >60° released, arm ≥85° open, tools returned and hands off 20 s; candidate requires two sensed geometric registrations held 3 s.
comparison.reason: Fastener release is only a shared primitive; the tested adjustment and feedback loops differ. Candidate fastener torque and allowable tightening drift remain unspecified.
